baseUrl.description: Kibana base URL, for example https://kibana.example.com:5601.

skipTlsVerify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification. Strictly equivalent to tlsInsecureSkipVerify and insecureSkipVerify: if any alias is true, verification is skipped; false does not override another true alias.

tlsInsecureSkipVerify.description: Strict alias for skipTlsVerify. If any TLS-skip alias is true, verification is skipped; false does not override another true alias.

insecureSkipVerify.description: Strict alias for skipTlsVerify. If any TLS-skip alias is true, verification is skipped; false does not override another true alias.
